# UxPlay runtime location

Place a tested `uxplay.exe` and the DLL/plugin runtime it needs here, or set the
`UXPLAY_PATH` environment variable. A lone executable copied out of MSYS2 is usually
not sufficient because GStreamer and MinGW runtime DLLs/plugins are required.

UxPlay is GPL-3.0. If it is distributed with this application, provide its complete
corresponding source and all required license notices. See `docs/LICENSES.md`.
